parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer used for storage within the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides enclosed storage space for small items and slides in and out of the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Moves linearly along rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden drawer identical in function to the first.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden back panel that supports the rear structure of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural rigidity and prevents drawers from sliding out the back.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel forming part of the drawer compartment.

parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.
